# Original ORR-IMS learning templates

**Public learning release — Draft.** Twelve original document-type demonstrations
support one bounded concern-to-action learning workflow. This is not a complete
P01–P23 implementation library, an exhaustive ISO mapping or an operational system.
Each adopting organization must supply actual scope, authority, obligations,
technical criteria and evidence. The 2026-10-31 publication decision is recorded in repository governance;
publication does not confer organizational approval.

| Type | Template / example |

| FWK | [Learning-library framework](ORR-FWK-GEN-001_LEARNING-FRAMEWORK.md) |
| POL | [Evidence and accountable decisions — policy template](ORR-POL-GEN-001_EVIDENCE-POLICY.md) |
| STD | [Original ORR decision and evidence requirements](ORR-STD-GEN-001_ORIGINAL-REQUIREMENTS.md) |

Start with the framework, policy and original requirements, then follow the process,
procedure and desk instruction. Use the blank plan/form/register for configuration;
read the fictional record/protocol/report to see why evidence and closure differ.

The original requirements use ORR IDs. Two proposed ISO reference mappings contain
only edition/clause identifiers and remain explicitly unverified. No source texts,
tables, diagrams or exhaustive requirement paraphrases were exported. Attribution
and rights boundaries are in [SOURCES](../../SOURCES.md) and
[LICENSING](../../LICENSING.md). Documentation controls are in the
[public control standard](../governance/ORR-STD-DOC-001_DOCUMENT-CONTROL.md).

Do not populate public examples with real client/employee/incident information.
Fictional answers and records are not human usability trials. All operational
approvals remain pending. These limitations do not prevent learning from an
honestly labelled draft; they constrain what may be claimed from it.
